decks.name: LeetCode #20 - Valid Parentheses
decks.description: Determine if a string of brackets is valid with proper opening and closing pairs

cards.question: Valid Parentheses: Given a string s containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid. An input string is valid if: 1) Open brackets must be closed by the same type of brackets. 2) Open brackets must be closed in the correct order. 3) Every close bracket has a corresponding open bracket of the same type.

solutions.name: Stack
solutions.explanation: Use a stack to track opening brackets. When we encounter a closing bracket, check if it matches the most recent opening bracket on the stack. Push opening brackets onto the stack and pop when we find matching closing brackets. The string is valid if the stack is empty at the end.

solutions.timeDescription: Linear time where n is the length of the string. We traverse the string once, with each push and pop operation taking O(1) time.
solutions.spaceDescription: Linear space for the stack. In the worst case (all opening brackets), the stack contains all n characters.
solutions.exampleWalkthrough: For s='()[]{}': Process '(', push to stack. Process ')', matches '(', pop. Process '[', push. Process ']', matches '[', pop. Process '{', push. Process '}', matches '{', pop. Stack empty, return true.

solutions.name: Brute Force
solutions.explanation: Repeatedly search for and remove matching pairs of brackets ('()', '[]', '{}') from the string until no more pairs can be found. If the string becomes empty, it was valid. Simple but inefficient with O(n²) time complexity due to repeated string operations.
